name: comp-179
title: Switch With Status Label
blurb: Switch with visible On/Off status label.
description: Toggle switch with dynamic status label showing current state. Built on shadcn's Switch with state management.
use_when: When users benefit from explicit state labels, especially on mobile or in forms.
avoid_when: When the switch context is clear and space is limited.
a11y: Built on accessible Switch primitive with aria-label and visible status text.
